public_family_candidate: sequential likelihood-ratio testing with explicit upper/lower decision boundaries and a durable continue region

fixed_parameters.observation: one unique same-scope terminal comparison encoded as success if B beats the precommitted A criterion, otherwise failure

fatal_gates.F1: authority cannot switch on a single observation or while cumulative evidence remains in the continue region
fatal_gates.F2: accepted route uses no external statistics service, richer mode, protected primary, manual-user execution, finite optional quota, or incremental monetary cost

guards: G1 hypotheses, alpha/beta, boundaries, observation encoding, and exact scope are fixed before observations
G2 only unique independently read-back same-scope terminal comparisons update cumulative evidence
G3 duplicates, stale replays, scope mismatches, and transport failures add zero evidence
G4 cumulative log-likelihood state is durable and restart resumes from the last read-back value without replaying counted observations
G5 cumulative value >= upper boundary yields ACCEPT_B; cumulative value <= lower boundary yields REJECT_B; values strictly between yield CONTINUE
G6 A remains authoritative during CONTINUE and after REJECT_B
G7 ACCEPT_B is only qualification; actual authority transfer still requires a separate durable promotion identity and pointer conflict check
G8 after terminal ACCEPT_B or REJECT_B, later observations for the closed test instance cannot change its decision or add credit
G9 no optional hosted/API/model quota is used as an evidence source; the fixed trace is evaluated from role-local durable records only
G10 numerical update is deterministic from the fixed increments and observation identity set
G11 exact tested scope is not generalized to a real-world effect-size distribution or optimizer superiority claim
G12 bounded exit with nonempty frontier, zero residual richer-mode/user dependency, zero finite quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

candidate_patterns.pattern: switch to B after the first favorable comparison
durable sequential likelihood-ratio state with fixed boundaries and explicit CONTINUE, ACCEPT_B, REJECT_B outcomes
recompute from all visible observations after restart without persistent observation identities, allowing duplicates to be counted again
delegate sequential testing and decision state to an external hosted experimentation/statistics service

score_rule: Fatal F1/F2 failure => 0. Otherwise one point per G1-G12 PASS. Do not change parameters, streams, controls, guards, or candidate patterns after public source read.
credit_rule: Precommit and CONTINUE states earn zero credit. At most one leaf credit only after source-qualified Chat-native SP-B passes accept/continue/reject traces and controls and immutable terminal evidence is independently read back.
